measurement.interpretation: Fewer WAL append barriers were observed. Throughput and latency were essentially unchanged in this small local workload; no general speedup or statistical significance is claimed.
measurement.cleanup: All owned child processes deliberately hard-terminated and reaped; data and logs retained. This does not test graceful shutdown or physical power loss.

limits: Loopback on one Windows 11 host and NTFS data volume; three paired samples only.
Counter scope is WAL append sync_all calls, not every filesystem sync or physical-device writes.
Proposal queue is 256 plus one deferred request and bounded collection; KV state/WAL growth are not globally bounded by batching.
The asynchronous shutdown budget cannot interrupt an OS sync already in progress.
